quotes.text: For D331827 at e624c1bb08469ad59e0a6905c62f604a2d1ee68c, the review reports that native row invalidation did not repair search-window selection after message removal. Removing the last result left selectedIndex and currentIndex beyond the remaining rows; removing all results left a nonempty selection. The existing middle-row test passed because its index remained valid. When changing this handler, preserve the saved post-delete index, clamp it to the remaining list, clear selection for an empty list, and notify the database view of selection changes. Minimum test coverage: remove the last result and all results, as well as a middle result. The recorded local repair and tests reportedly passed with 67 passed and 2 todo; no published review outcome or landing is supplied.
